Episode 230. Invasion and Raid (1)
"If we keep up this pace, Sakiel's legacy will completely disappear in three days."
What Jin referred to as a 'legacy' was the grand magic of Loss that Sakiel had cast.

In the destroyed Grosh Castle and its vicinity, white magical energy was swirling. Although not as comprehensive as the fully unleashed magic, the remnants of the Field of Loss were still significantly threatening.
"It seems so. Looking back, it was indeed a great magic. If it wasn't for you, we wouldn't have been able to avoid severe damage."

"Your decision to not stop attacking even after recognizing the Field of Loss was also significant, Dante. If you hadn't been there in the first place, it would've been harder to prepare for the reversal."
"Thanks for saying that. By the way, I'm worried about Lady Valeria. She's not resting at all, busy verifying the battlefield records."
"She said it's a form of practicing record magic, so it's actually beneficial. You don't have to worry too much, she's the toughest person I know."
"Oh... I never expected to see such a soft side to you."
Dante poked Jin's side and laughed. But after a while, he looked back and felt a chill.
Sandra Ziffle was staring at Dante with a bright smile in her eyes.
"Veil, it seems the Sword Emperor has drunk something wrong. Go poke him, anywhere. Preferably the tongue would be nice."
[What are you talking about, Sandra Ziffle?]
"You have to obey my orders unconditionally, right? You swore and pledged in gold."
[Ah, stop it. If I did such a thing, I'd be exiled from the Alliance.]
"Ahaha, I know, I'm just joking. Right, Lord Dante?"
"The atmosphere is awkward, hey Veil. Do that thing, that thing."
[What thing?]
"You know, the catchphrase that became popular among the Alliance members."
[Oh, I did it just a while ago.]
"Do it quickly."
Veil resisted for a moment, her face flushed, but in the end, she had no choice but to obey Sandra's order.
[......I am invincible and immortal, and you are weak and finite.]
"Pfft."
"Phew."
The nearby colleagues burst into laughter they'd been holding back.
[I am one of the ten knights of Runcandel, the being who exterminates the enemy of my family, the nemesis of mortals... yes, I am... Veil Runcandel...]
Eek eek eek! As Veil continued her lines, the colleagues eventually fell over, clutching their stomachs in laughter. Even Dante pointed at Veil, making a chuckling sound.
Sandra, on the other hand, kept her gaze fixed on Jin's laughing figure, a satisfied smile on her face.
"It's nice to see you laugh, Mr. Jin. Sandra Ziffle has work to do, so I'll leave you to it. Let's go, invincible and immortal. You have a lot to do too. Lord Dante, no more silly jokes, okay?"
With that, Sandra left the meeting room.
The party naturally shifted their gazes to the newspapers on the table.
(The Victory of the Barmel Alliance! Alliance Chief Jin Runcandel, along with the Sword Emperor, topples Grosh Castle.)
(Even though major forces of Inse participated in the siege, it is known that the Barmel Alliance was the first to break through the defenses and topple the castle.)
(It was confirmed that in the siege of Grosh Castle, the Ruter Magic Federation and Kinzelo suffered significant losses to their fleets. On the other hand, the Barmel Alliance......)
Newspapers from around the world were continuously publishing articles about the siege of Grosh Castle.
Reporters of the Barmel Alliance, led by Dino Jagglun, emphasized 'The Victory of the Barmel Alliance', while others emphasized 'The Victory of Inse'.
However, even the people of Ruter Federation trusted the alliance's newspaper more.

This was because Valeria's records were included in the articles of the alliance. Although Ruter Federation and Kinzelo were blocking the distribution of the alliance's newspaper, they couldn't deal with all the Rainbow Bird agents already infiltrated in their areas.

After the Hall of Misfortune, Valeria's record magic became one of the symbols of absolute trust to the public. The only countermeasure the Federation and Kinzelo could take was to attack the alliance on the grounds of 'the risk of the power of record magic'.
On one hand, it was a valid criticism, but it had no other effect. It was wartime all over the world, not a time of peace.
"One of the purposes of the maneuver has been achieved. In the public eye, we're the ones saving Inse from the Demon Realm now."
[Ha ha, in reality, we are indeed the ones protecting it. Speaking bluntly, even without Ziffle and Kinzelo, Grosh Castle would have eventually fallen to the Chief. Isn't that right, Lady Ameris?]
"It would have been, Faytel."

"Now the Federation and Kinzelo will want to hide the fact that they appeared weaker than us on the same battlefield. They might overexert themselves, or deploy hidden forces. They will likely try to build larger forces as quickly as possible and station them again at Grosh Castle because now we have to enter the Demon World."
Until then, there was no reason for the alliance to enter the Demon World first.
Although they had brought down Grosh Castle much easier than expected, the reality was that the Demon World's forces had not decreased by even 10% from this battle.

'The remaining forces alone are at least 50 billion... moreover, there are more than a hundred Demon Kings left. There will also be new Demon Kings who have risen to fill the vacant places of the dead ones.'

Of course, no matter how many soldiers and superhuman forces like the Demon Kings there are, their abilities are lowered due to brainwashing. As revealed in several previous battles, most of these Demon Kings could not stand against the superior superhumans of Inseo.
"Reports are continually coming in from the Rainbow Association and the Nameless, Jin. Both Kinzelo and Ziphl are gathering new fleets again," Quicantel said.
"What's the scale?"

"Roughly more than twice that deployed in the siege of Grosh Castle. No matter how great their production capacity is, it's an impossible speed. So, they must have mixed in several hidden fleets from places like the underground construction site in Sota Desert. The exterior of the existing fleets is also slightly different. They're probably ships with higher-level technology."
Jin nodded his head.
"Is the crew mainly composed of life golems, also known as Myeong-in and Ma-ryeong?"
"That's what they say. And the speed at which they're produced is unguessable. However, the intelligence says it's definitely much faster than making fleets."
"In my opinion, the speed at which Myeong-in and Ma-ryeong are produced is impossible with human power, no matter how good the technology is."
So, Ameris guessed that Ziphl and Kinzelo each received 'divine' help in producing biological weapons.
"That must be the power of the Sun God. Orgal met Veil through a deal with you and regained some of the Sun God's power. Ziphl has a Sun Priestess, so they must be using that power."
They were at war with the Demon World, so it was a problem that couldn't be looked into for now. But one thing was certain.
"In the war that will be fought on the Demon World mainland, we must prevent them from gaining additional power from the Sun God."

"You understood it right away. Currently, Jito dominates the Demon World, but fundamentally, Hell is underground, where the Sun God died. It's not strange if those who covet that power find something more in that region. The relatively calm Enemy Tribe these days is probably preparing too. Currently, they know the geography of the underworld the best."
As Ameris predicted, the Enemy Tribe and the royal family were also planning to join the melee in Hell and get rewards.
"That would be the case. Particularly, the Red Myojin are the race that uses the power of the sun god best, so there could be no better time to aim for a turnaround."

"I've said this before, but the original losers of the ancient underworld were not the demons, but the Myojin of that era. Even though they're being pushed by the Jipel now, it wouldn't be strange if something happens the moment they gain additional power from the sun god. Above all, it seems that they have not yet found a sacrifice."
One had to be careful in everything, both in entering the true devil world and after entry.

"Although all elements of the war are fraught with opaque dangers even after attacking Grosha Castle, fortunately, thanks to Valeria, we have the ability to follow and find out what the enemies are plotting. After entering, let's wage war by thoroughly checking the records of the underworld."

"It's a shame that Butler Loret can't move with us. The fairy's authority that the child has is also on par with Valeria. Well, that child is also continuing to check the records related to Jipel and Kinsel."
Jin looked at Grosha Castle, enveloped in pure white magic, from the deck of the ship. Valeria was in the center, examining the records of the battlefield under the protection of Murakan.
"Perhaps. No, surely. We'll have to fight the demons one more time before we enter the true devil world."
Throughout the battle of Grosha Castle, Jin felt a strange sense of discomfort.
The largest stronghold in Inse is being pushed so overwhelmingly, yet Jito never once sent a reinforcement like Paelito, who is considered the strongest.
Jin even had the impression that Jito was enjoying watching the death of his men. It seemed he didn't care even if his flesh was wasted meaninglessly.
"Jito's eye, that's why."

"That's right, Lord Quicantel. According to the information given by Bicepts, the current strongest in the true devil world is Paelito, who is assumed to be Changsung, even though he is completely brainwashed... and following him are Ridolros and Bideluche. Jito will definitely order them to come find his eye."
"The Holy Kingdom Defense War will be reproduced."

"Of course, the three of them alone won't be able to penetrate the Holy Kingdom. There's a protective barrier that Ayura has spread all over the Holy Kingdom, and the major superhumans of Inse will also be waiting. However, it doesn't seem like Jito would just thoughtlessly send only the three of them to the Holy Kingdom."
Jin was aware of the transition crack.
The reason Jito didn't send reinforcements to Grosha Castle is to hit the Holy Kingdom.

"Before sending the strongest of the true devil world to the Holy Kingdom, they will scatter our forces. They will scatter transition cracks all over the world. The most appropriate time would be now when all the forces of Inse are still gathered at Grosha Castle."

"Even so, we won't be affected much. It's just a matter of time before we send the Red Owl and other superhumans back to their territories in the coalition. But because of that, there's also a high chance that we'll have to face the strongest of the true devil world alone. The other forces will be too busy protecting their territories. Orgal's side is relatively better."
At Quicantel's words, Jin nodded.

"Yes, the strongest demons in the true devil world that will attack the Holy Kingdom will be mainly our opponents. So everyone, be prepared. The fight that will take place in the Holy Kingdom will not be as easy to win as the battle of Grosha Castle."
